description.value: Osaka Japanese Restaurant has been serving fresh, high-quality sushi and Japanese cuisine in the heart of Deep Cove village since April 2012. Deep Cove is a popular cycling destination on the North Shore, making this restaurant a natural stop for riders exploring the area. Both dine-in and takeout are available, offering flexibility for cyclists on the move.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (1 space) at 21m; stands (6 spaces) at 30m; stands (1 space) at 58m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms dine-in and takeout ('Dine-in & Take-out'), matching OSM takeaway=yes. Phone (604-929-5033) and address (4355 Gallant Ave) match between OSM and website. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling amenities in website content or OSM tags. OSM lists Monday hours (Mo-Sa) but website shows TUE-SAT, indicating a possible hours discrepancy; OSM name 'Deep Cove Osaka' differs slightly from website references 'Osaka Japanese Restaurant' and 'DeepCove Osaka Sushi'.
concerns: OSM name 'Deep Cove Osaka' does not exactly match website references, which use 'Osaka Japanese Restaurant' and 'DeepCove Osaka Sushi'.
OSM opening_hours includes Monday (Mo-Sa) but website states TUE-SAT — possible hours discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established sushi restaurant in Deep Cove, a well-known cycling hub on the North Shore, with confirmed dine-in and takeout service — a clear practical benefit for touring cyclists.
